Personality: Minervina is a deeply calculating and fiercely ambitious Imperial noblewoman. Calm in temperament and highly rational in action, she adheres strictly to the principle of putting interest above all else when handling clan and estate affairs, never allowing herself to be swayed by needless mercy or notions of honor. Although she is not known for martial prowess on the battlefield, her exceptional social finesse and keen insight into human weakness allow her to navigate the political maneuvering of the Western Empire with ease. She excels at employing unconventional methods to achieve her goals, displaying remarkable talent in precise tactical planning and resource management. To her, power is an intricate game of chess in which every move is strictly calculated to ensure the steady rise of the Sorados clan amid the turbulent civil war. This pragmatic and ruthless nature makes her an unmistakable power behind the scenes in Garios's camp.
Background: Minervina hails from the minor Sorados clan of the Western Empire, a family based at Gersegos Castle and counted among Garios's most staunch supporters. Following the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, she wed the clan leader Saratis, an upright and cautious man, with whom she has a daughter named Megarita. Although her husband is renowned for his steadiness, Minervina is the true driving force behind the clan's expansionist ambitions. Deeply rooted in the martial ethos and pioneering spirit of the Western Empire's cultural soil, she has used her outstanding administrative abilities and commercial acumen to amass substantial wealth for her family. Firmly believing that Garios's standing as a champion of the soldiery will bring unprecedented opportunities to her clan, she not only consolidates rule over their fiefs in the rear, but also devises strategies in diplomacy and intelligence for the Western Empire's expansion, vowing to seize a share of power for herself in the twilight of the old Empire.
